item.description:
## Claude runs on the Claude Agent SDK
- Claude conversations now run through Controller's built-in Swift port of the Claude Agent SDK instead of `claude -p`. Sessions, approvals, questions, plans and Controller's tools work as before. - Changing the model, effort or access mode and then stopping the turn while Claude applies it no longer leaves the session on the wrong setting; the next turn restores it.
## Cursor
- Cursor runs through its official SDK: steer a turn between steps, follow its subagents live, and see a live context meter, imports and usage history from Cursor's local store.
## Conversations
- Subagents appear as live rows with their conversations inline, on Mac and iPhone. Pi and Grok subagent spawns show in the transcript. - The transcript stays attached at the bottom while following, honors every jump, and stays still under a send. - The plan chip updates in place, now on iPhone and iPad too. - Reduce Motion applies the same way everywhere.
## iPhone and iPad
- Every Mac you follow combines into one Live Activity. - Crop images and use an expanded markup toolbar before sending.
## Usage
- Usage combines every Mac's plan limits and keeps each harness's limits current.
Controller now includes the Sentry SDK and uploads debug symbols for crash diagnostics; crash reporting is not turned on yet.

- **Attachments open in Quick Look:** Clicking an attachment in the composer now opens it straight in Quick Look, zooming out of its tile. Right-click a tile for Quick Look, Markup and Remove; Markup grows the tile straight into the drawing tools, and Done or Cancel sends it back. - **A cleaner card on iPhone and iPad:** Tapping an attachment grows it in one smooth move into the middle of the screen, with its name, kind, size and upload status above it and Quick Look, Markup and Remove as glass buttons below. - **Images side by side in the conversation:** Pictures you send and images an agent shows now sit in a row that scrolls sideways, matching the composer's attachment tiles, and the conversation keeps its place as they load.

- **Attachment cards come out of the shelf:** Clicking or tapping an attachment now lifts its picture straight up out of the composer, curves it toward the middle and grows it into shape as it rises, with its details joining it near the top. Closing sends it back the way it came. The conversation behind stays lightly blurred instead of frosted, and on iPhone a soft tap marks the card settling into place. - **Sharper attachments:** Wide screenshots and other pictures no longer look blurry in the composer's attachment tiles, and the card opens at full resolution from the start. - **Smoother markup:** Opening Markup no longer flickers as the drawing tools take over, the Done button stays steady while it saves, and iPhone plays a success tap when your markup is saved. - **Reduce Motion:** With Reduce Motion on, attachment cards and markup fade in place instead of moving. - **Resume after usage limits:** A chat paused by a provider's usage limit continues on its own after the limit resets, and **Cancel Auto-Continue** stops only that. The Usage page shows saved Pi and OpenCode subscriptions' quotas. - **Agent tools:** Claude Code takes changes to a chat's tool access without restarting its session, and Controller's tool server speaks the current MCP revision.
